newsitem.title: NORWAY: BP/Statoil group moves on with Vietnam gas project.
newsitem.headline: BP/Statoil group moves on with Vietnam gas project.

text.p: A preliminary engineering contract for developing the Lan Tay and Lan Do gas fields in block 1/6 off southern Vietnam has been put out to tender by the British Petroleum Co Plc /Statoil alliance, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
The tender covers a platform and production wells and a 390-km pipeline to a terminal southwest of Ho Chi Minh City, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
The deadline for the bids is February 5 and contracts are expected to be awarded during the spring. Construction should start within a year.
Statoil said, however, that terms for a gas sales contract must first be agreed to determine whether a development would be sufficiently profitable.

The two fields contain around 58 billion cubic metres of gas, which will probably be used for power generation in the Ho Chi Minh area. A possible fertiliser plant also had been studied by the alliance, Statoil said.
